chunks: Ahmad b. Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me, from my grandfather, from Ali b. Ma'bad, from al-Husayn b. Khalid, from Abu al-Hasan Ali b. Musa al-Rida, from his father Musa b. Ja'far, from his father Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father Muhammad b. Ali, from his father Ali b. al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn b. Ali, from his father the Commander of the Faithful Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon them all). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Gabriel informed me from Allah, exalted is His majesty, that He said:

Ali b. Abi Talib is My Proof over My creation and the upholder of My religion. I shall bring forth from his loins Imams who will establish My command and call to My way. By them I repel the chastisement from My male and female servants, and by them I bring down My mercy.

key_terms.أئمة: Imams; divinely appointed leaders from the progeny of Ali
key_terms.جبرئيل: Gabriel (Jibril); the archangel who conveys divine revelation
key_terms.حجتي: My proof (hujjati); the divinely appointed authority over creation
key_terms.ديان ديني: The upholder of My religion; one who maintains and guards the faith

ai.seo_question: What did Allah say about Ali b. Abi Talib and the Imams from his descendants?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated through the golden chain (silsilat al-dhahab) passing through all twelve Imams, the Prophet Muhammad (s) relays a divine statement from Allah conveyed through the angel Gabriel: that Ali b. Abi Talib is Allah's proof over His creation and the upholder of His religion, and that from Ali's descendants will come Imams who will establish Allah's command, invite to His path, repel divine chastisement from His servants, and be the channels through which His mercy descends. This narration is significant as a hadith qudsi (divine statement) explicitly naming Ali and the Imams from his lineage as divine proofs.
